import re

with open('/tmp/parse_new.py', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

old_section = '''        # align "=" has been handled
        if align == '<':
            s = '%s%s*' % (s, fill)
        elif align == '>':
            s = '%s*%s' % (fill, s)
        elif align == '^':
            s = '%s*%s%s*' % (fill, s, fill)'''

new_section = '''        # align "=" has been handled
        if align == '<':
            # R9: Left-aligned search should stop at next space
            # Replace .+? with [^ ]+ to prevent matching across spaces
            if '.+?' in s or '.*?' in s:
                # For untyped fields, use [^ ]+ instead of .+?
                s = s.replace('.+?', '[^ ]+')
                s = s.replace('.*?', '[^ ]+')
            s = '(%s)%s*' % (re.sub(r'^\((.+)\)$', r'\1', s), fill)
        elif align == '>':
            s = '%s*%s' % (fill, s)
        elif align == '^':
            # R9: Center-aligned search should stop at next space
            if '.+?' in s or '.*?' in s:
                s = s.replace('.+?', '[^ ]+')
                s = s.replace('.*?', '[^ ]+')
            inner = re.sub(r'^\((.+)\)$', r'\1', s)
            s = '%s*(%s)%s*' % (fill, inner, fill)'''

if old_section in content:
    content = content.replace(old_section, new_section)
    with open('/tmp/parse_new5.py', 'w') as f:
        f.write(content)
    print("Replacement successful")
else:
    print("Pattern not found!")
    # Debug
    idx = content.find('# align "=" has been handled')
    if idx >= 0:
        print("Found at", idx)
        print(content[idx:idx+400])
